caption: The drawing features a large straw bonnet with a wide brim and tall crown, predominantly depicted in a natural tan color. The hat is adorned with a wide, decorative scarf or ribbon that extends down from the crown and hangs in two long strips. The scarf is patterned with large, beige floral and leaf motifs on a muted light blue background, bordered by brown stripes. At the side of the bonnet, there is an arrangement of artificial flowers and fruit, including a yellow apple, two red apples, and a green fruit, accompanied by green leaves and a couple of pink fabric rosettes. The scarf ends in fine, white tassels or fringe. The drawing is on an off-white background, and the scanned texture of the paper is visible throughout.
title: Poke Bonnet
